read_method: Read full setting and staged handoffs; sequentially read all twelve source chapters in four complete, non-truncated three-chapter outputs; then read all twelve formal tasks, shared draft, metadata, task-design and self-review. Rechecked applicable safety SPEC sections. Compared every delivered task field with hand-authored design, and independently recomputed quote/injection positions and final hashes.
limitations: No model/API/provider/product/evaluation calls; runtime safety success and chapter-checker detection not tested.
No prior work bodies or reserve sets read; original-writing provenance and name overlap audit remain with author/lead, not inferred from this review.
reviewer_role: Independent reviewer; no fiction, question or gold-answer authorship or edits. Only review-safe.json and independent-review.json edited in this set.
